_doc: CAD spec for T6 GLASS MULTIDOSE VIAL hero. Layout from canonical target (tmp/discovery/T6_target.png, 934x1066). Small clear glass vial with a BLUE/navy aluminium crimp flip-cap, clear liquid. White label on the lower body, navy text left-aligned: Regenic logo (navy + cyan leaf), product name, dose, then a small route + form line (e.g. 'IV  2ml Multidose Vial'). Sole SKU = wolverine-stack (Section 21 -> NO badge). gpt_image_2 generative + reference; prompt defers to reference.

object.container: small clear glass injection vial with a glossy navy-blue aluminium crimp flip-cap and clear liquid contents

prompt_template: Photorealistic e-commerce hero render of a small clear glass injection vial with a glossy navy-blue aluminium crimp flip-cap and clear liquid. Match the attached reference image EXACTLY for vial shape, blue crimp cap, glass, label shape and placement, materials and lighting — change ONLY the printed label text. BACKGROUND seamless very-light grey, soft key top-left, vial vertically centered, soft contact shadow. The white label on the lower body carries, left-aligned, NAVY text: the 'Regenic|Lab' wordmark navy #1b2846 with cyan leaf; the product name '{product_name}' in Montserrat SemiBold navy (largest); {dose_clause}then a small muted-grey line 'SC · Multidose Vial' in Montserrat Medium #5b687b. TYPOGRAPHY DISCIPLINE: replicate reference sizes/spacing exactly, modest, legible, do not enlarge; if no dose specified do NOT invent one. There is NO schedule badge. No 'Novecy' or third-party branding. Clean premium clinical pharmacy, sharp focus, sRGB. Portrait 934x1066.
